quotes.text: Copilot doesn't bypass permissions. It respects them exactly as they're set. If a document is locked down to five people, the sixth person's copilot can't pull it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Corrects the most common misunderstanding about Copilot and permissions.

quotes.text: A hub doesn't grant access to anything. If you associate a site with a hub, nobody gains the right to open it. Nobody loses a right either.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clears up the widespread belief that hubs pass permissions down.

quotes.text: So here's the rule of thumb if you can't explain who has access to a site in one sentence, the design is wrong.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A simple, testable rule for permission design.

quotes.text: Copilot doesn't create oversharing. It makes it discoverable. Those two statements sound close. They're not. One says the tool introduced a problem. The other says the problem was already sitting in your tenant
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes Copilot risk as pre-existing permission debt.

Site lifecycle, cleanup and governance operations

takeaways: Copilot respects permissions exactly as they are set, so it surfaces every old company-wide link, open group and broken inheritance that obscurity used to hide.
Measure exposure first, then design sites by purpose and audience with group-based permissions, safe sharing defaults, sensitivity labels and shared content types so the right file wins retrieval.
Treat governance as operations: give every site owners and an end date, automate inactive and ownerless site policies, archive stale content and test Copilot with a recurring prompt set.
hook: Copilot does not browse your SharePoint navigation; it retrieves whatever a user can reach and whatever matches the prompt. This episode is for SharePoint architects, information managers, Microsoft 365 admins and Copilot rollout teams. You learn how sites, hubs, permissions, labels, metadata and lifecycle policies combine into an information architecture that keeps Copilot answers safe and correct.
